scope: Independent primary-methods adjudication; not a model inclusion override or a new mortality estimate
registry_quote: To evaluate the percentage of death.
registry_locator: Original registration, Primary outcomes, English mortality field
observations: Original registry specifies ten-day drug regimens, hospitalization duration from admission to discharge, ICU admission and mortality, but no scheduled mortality follow-up interval.
Primary paper describes daily evaluation, discharge criteria and observed hospital courses. It does not establish complete mortality ascertainment at a scheduled21–28-day horizon.
These sources establish an eligible randomized trial with reported mortality data; they do not identify the protocol-defined mortality timepoint.
A10-day treatment course is not a10-day mortality follow-up; individual23/26-day stays do not establish scheduled follow-up for all participants.
Published review classifies discharge-only mortality separately, but secondary classification alone is not used to override the primary-input contract.
decision: Retain unresolved target follow-up under unchanged v1 contract; neither exclude trial nor pool its deaths as21/28-day mortality.
